author: rApq
content: OBSOLETE — superseded by the two-syntax architecture decision (user-confirmed close). The proposed 'unify into one shared sort-typed Frm' is the path we deliberately did NOT take: Thermite.Strat.Frm (minimal semantic spine, REQ-1) and Thermite.Strat.Cls.Frm (rich sort-typed classifier surface, REQ-3) are kept SEPARATE on purpose — the spine's var-only Tm cannot hold the Read/Len/Cast/IdxOp array vocabulary, so a total meaning-preserving unification is ill-defined (this was REQ-5 option A, evaluated and rejected). The #68 axiom-probe Atom.ctorElim collision was resolved by namespacing the classifier under .Cls (REQ-3 #325), and the two surfaces are bridged by the REQ-5 encoder (option B: encode Cls.Frm directly, T1-S against structural fdenote — #327 @99ea373a). Stage 2 shipped through Gate G2 @8547e2b9 with this architecture. No unification needed.
